conventions.decoded: present only when expect is ok; type is the numeric frame type, payload_hex the payload bytes in lowercase hex
conventions.expect: ok: the frame passes every stateless check of preview tunnel v1 T2; close_1002: the receiver closes the tunnel with close code 1002
conventions.frames: stateless decoding only; stream ordering, windows and limits are covered by sequences
conventions.hex: one complete websocket binary message, lowercase hex: 1 byte type, 4 bytes big-endian stream id, then the payload
conventions.open: present for OPEN: the strictly parsed preview_id and preview_key
conventions.reset_code: present for RESET: the code name the receiver acts on; an unknown code decodes ok and maps to protocol
conventions.sequences: stateful replays against a runner that knows known_previews; from gateway is a message the runner receives, replies_hex the messages the runner sends in order
conventions.stream_id_rule: every frame needs an odd, non-zero stream id; even ids are a protocol error in both directions
conventions.window_credit: present for WINDOW: the uint32 big-endian credit
